description: On a writable copy of the base fixture, indexes are created on TableDef T through TableDef.CreateIndex, Index.CreateField and Indexes.Append, with DBEngine.Errors after each Append: ixDaoA on A with Unique and IgnoreNulls set True; ixDaoDesc on B with the index field's Attributes set to 1; ixDaoPrimary on C with Primary set True (T already has a primary key); ixDaoReq on B and A with Required True and Clustered True. T's Indexes (after Refresh) are then listed with Name, Primary, Unique, Clustered, IgnoreNulls, Required, Foreign, DistinctCount and Fields (Name, Attributes), and again after Close and reopen.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
